title: "A Beautiful Graphic"
author: "mariana comartin"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, alpha = 0.82) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel economy falls as engines grow larger",
    subtitle = "Vehicles in the built-in mpg dataset",
    x = "Engine displacement (litres)",
    y = "Highway fuel economy (mpg)",
    color = "Vehicle class",
    caption = "Source: ggplot2::mpg"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
